title: Skull Alien Cheese Ritual
description: A red cracked skull-headed alien in a green crop top and shorts kneels on a cobblestone plaza, eating a cheese-topped flatbread. She holds a large ray gun pointed at a plate of similar food, with a transparent bubble chair, colorful balloon-like orbs, a gothic striped cathedral, and a vintage orange car in the surreal background.
prompt: A surreal scene on a cobblestone plaza featuring a red cracked skull-headed female alien with glowing eyes, wearing a bright green crop top and denim shorts, kneeling while eating a cheesy flatbread. She holds a futuristic ray gun aimed at a plate of food. Behind her is a transparent bubble chair, colorful balloon orbs on stands, a gothic cathedral with black and white stripes, and a vintage orange car. Floating bubbles and sparks fill the air under a dramatic split-color sky.
